panel.title: Linked Exploration
panel.subtitle: Multi-chart combined filtering · one source revision · named views

conditions.empty: No conditions yet — click a category or range bin on a chart

preview.idle: Bind a source and add charts to start exploring
preview.facetNote: In-chart statistics use the “options under other conditions” scope (own condition excluded); the matched total uses the all-conditions scope

table.error: Read failed (condition JSON may exceed limits or source advanced)
table.empty: Empty set — 0 matches (never falls back to full source)

views.needTitleAndPlan: Need a title and a bound source
views.stalePrompt: Source advanced — view keeps its original anchor; re-preview/re-bind before saving

chart.truncatedNote: Categories over the limit merged into other (see panel for overflow values)
chart.otherNotFilterable: Overflow values over budget, not filterable

multiSource.propUnfiltered: upstream has no active conditions: no propagation restriction
multiSource.unprojected: composite-key propagation: map filter not exactly projectable (stats exact)
multiSource.handleSkipped: scope handle not expressible: results table withheld (no over-broad impersonation)
multiSource.empty: Run a multi-source plan preview to see per-source scope and metrics
